text: Closing the paper trail: a formal risk-register entry for a fix that already shipped, written for the compliance file.
The fix itself was small: rescope the Sentinel exclusion by sign-in type and app ID instead of a tag, and remove svc-core-banking-sync from its MFA exemption entirely.
Scored against Oakmere's own risk register, the gap was high inherent risk, realized on October 12th; the applied fix drops it to low residual risk.
The cost was roughly a sprint of engineering time against tooling already owned; the already-realized cost of the gap was a 36-hour detection miss against a signed-off 4-hour target.
Next: the after-action report, with owned, dated follow-up items.
